sensesIntro.en: Wrinkle starts with a fold on skin, spreads to cloth and paper, turns into the act of folding, then becomes a problem, a trick, or a property of cloth.
sensesIntro.cn: wrinkle 从皮肤上的褶开始，扩展到布与纸，再转化为「使起皱」的动作，随后引申为小问题、小妙计，以及布料的特性。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thumb and finger pinch a thin cloth and one fine line appears.
core.cn: 核心意象：拇指和食指捏起薄布，浮起一道细纹。

branches.en: The same fine fold sits on a face and on a shirt, only the material changes.
branches.cn: 同一道细褶既长在脸上也出现在衬衣上，变的只是材料。

branches.en: The fold turned into action gives the verb, in the face and in the fabric.
branches.cn: 把褶变成动作，就得到了动词：用在脸上，也用在织物上。

branches.en: A crease means something is not flat, so a wrinkle in a plan means it is not smooth yet.
branches.cn: 有褶说明东西还没铺平，所以计划里的皱褶就是说它还不够顺。

branches.en: A new fold in a familiar pattern becomes a clever new idea in American use.
branches.cn: 熟悉图案上新添的一道褶，在美式用法里成了聪明的新点子。

branches.en: Both ends of the family keep one small line, whether on a face or in a plan.
branches.cn: 这一族词的两端都保留着同一道小小的线，无论是在脸上还是在计划里。

intro.en: Wrinkle is a native noun and verb; its family grows with -ed, -y, -ing and the Greek prefix anti-.
intro.cn: wrinkle 是英语本族语的名词兼动词，它的同族词靠 -ed、-y、-ing 以及希腊语前缀 anti- 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Wrinkle has no Latin ancestor; the Latin entries below are related words of the folding and creasing field.
latinIntro.cn: wrinkle 没有拉丁语祖先；下面的拉丁同族词属于同一「折叠、起皱」义场的相关词。

items.example: Gewrinclod is the earliest recorded relative of wrinkle.
items.exampleCN: gewrinclod 是 wrinkle 最早有记录的亲属词。

items.example: Wrincle is the noun that becomes wrinkle.
items.exampleCN: wrincle 是演变为 wrinkle 的名词。

items.meaningCN: 构成表示状态的形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ed forms wrinkled.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成 wrinkled。

items.meaning: full of, having the quality of
items.example: The suffix -y forms the adjective wrinkly.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -y 构成形容词 wrinkly。

items.meaning: forming a noun of process or an action noun
items.meaningCN: 构成表示过程或动作名词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing forms wrinkling.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 wrinkling。

items.example: Anti- joins the noun in anti-wrinkle cream.
items.exampleCN: anti- 与名词结合成 anti-wrinkle cream。

items.example: The suffix -free forms wrinkle-free.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -free 构成 wrinkle-free。

items.example: You iron a garment to take out a wrinkle.
items.exampleCN: 熨衣服就是为了去掉皱褶。

definition_zh: 制造的；锻造的；精制的；引起（后果）的；worked 的古老过去分词形式
definition_en: made or shaped by hammering or working, especially of metal, or worked up as a past participle of work
core_image: 铁匠钳住烧红的铁条，一锤一锤把它打成想要的模样
scene: 老城区的铁匠铺里还挂着几件手工打制的旧灯架。On the gate hangs a wrought iron lamp shaped like a leaf.
sceneCN: 这里 wrought 是「锻造的、打制的」（第 1 个义项：金属经锤打成形）；句意：大门上挂着一盏打成叶子形状的锻铁灯。

pos.zh: worked 的古旧过去分词形式（现已少用）

collocations.zh: 过度紧张的；过于激动的

derivatives.zh: over-（过度）+ wrought，义为「过度紧张的、过于激动的」
wrought + up 构成，义为「情绪被搅动起来的、烦躁的」
in-（在内）+ wrought，义为「织入其中的、嵌饰的」，较罕见

senses.title: Shaped by hammering metal
senses.definition: made or shaped from metal by hammering or working it
senses.definitionCN: 把金属经锤打或加工制成形状的
senses.example: The balcony was decorated with wrought iron rails.
senses.exampleCN: 阳台装点着锻铁栏杆。
senses.why: Wrought is the old past participle of work, so metal that was worked by a smith is literally metal that has been work-ed.
senses.whyCN: wrought 是 work 的古过去分词，被工匠加工过的金属，字面上就是「被做过工」的金属。

senses.title: Made or produced by effort
senses.definition: made, produced, or brought about through effort
senses.definitionCN: 经过努力制造或成就出来的
senses.example: It was a reputation wrought over thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 那是用三十年时间打造出来的名声。
senses.why: Working on a thing is also making it, so wrought can describe anything produced by effort, not only metal.
senses.whyCN: 对一件东西下功夫就是制造它，因此 wrought 也能描述任何靠努力做出来的事物，而不只是金属。

senses.title: Crafted with care
senses.titleCN: 精工细作的；笔法讲究的
senses.definition: carefully and skilfully made, as of writing, art, or a design
senses.definitionCN: （文章、艺术品或设计）精心制作的、手法讲究的
senses.example: The essay is a finely wrought piece of argument.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇文章是一篇精心打磨的论证。
senses.why: When the effort is applied with care to shape something, worked comes to mean wrought with craft and finish.
senses.whyCN: 当功夫被细致地花在造型上时，worked 就引申为工艺与修饰上的讲究。

senses.title: Brought about as an effect
senses.definition: caused or brought about, as in wrought havoc or wrought a change
senses.definitionCN: 引起、造成（破坏、变化等），如「造成严重破坏」
senses.example: The storm wrought havoc along the whole coast.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨席卷整个海岸，造成了严重破坏。
senses.why: A thing that is wrought is a result that someone or something has worked into being, so wrought came to mean caused.
senses.whyCN: 被 wrought 出来的东西就是被某人或某物「做」出来的结果，所以 wrought 又有了「引起」的意思。

senses.title: Old participle past of work
senses.definition: the archaic past participle of work, now replaced by worked
senses.definitionCN: 动词 work 的古旧过去分词，今天已被 worked 取代
senses.example: He hath wrought wonders in the land.
senses.exampleCN: 他在那地行了奇事。
senses.why: Old English formed the past participle of wyrcan with a suffix or a vowel change, and wrought is the worn form that survived into English.
senses.whyCN: 古英语的 wyrcan 靠加词尾或换元音构成过去分词，wrought 是这一模式残留到英语中的旧形。

intro.en: Wrought is the old past participle of the verb work, from Old English wyrcan, and now survives mainly in compounds and set phrases.
intro.cn: wrought 是动词 work 的古老过去分词，源自古英语 wyrcan，今天主要存活于复合词与固定短语中。

items.en: The verb wyrcan means to work or make, and its past participle is worht or geworht.
items.cn: 古英语动词 wyrcan 意为「做工、制造」，其过去分词为 worht 或 geworht。

items.en: The spelling settles around wrought, still used as the participle of work.
items.cn: 拼写逐渐固定为 wrought，仍作 work 的过去分词使用。

items.en: Worked begins to compete, and wrought is kept more and more for metalwork and fine craft.
items.cn: worked 开始与之竞争，wrought 渐渐多用于金属加工与精细工艺。

items.en: The past participle sense is now archaic, while wrought iron and wrought havoc keep the old form alive.
items.cn: 过去分词用法如今已古旧，而 wrought iron 与 wrought havoc 让这个旧形留存下来。

items.en: Old participles such as molten and shorn show the same worn participle pattern, though the exact form of each word differs.
items.cn: 像 molten、shorn 这样的旧分词体现了相近的「磨旧」分词模式，但每个词的确切形式各有不同。

note.en: Wrought belongs to the work family, close in form to wright, and in meaning to forged, hammered, and wrought iron.
note.cn: wrought 属于 work 词族，形式上与 wright 相近，意义上靠近 forged、hammered 以及 wrought iron。

entries.definition: to do labour or to make something
entries.definitionCN: 劳动；制造

entries.definition: the modern past participle of work
entries.definitionCN: work 的现代过去分词

entries.definition: a maker or builder of something, as in wheelwright
entries.definitionCN: 制造者或建造者，如车轮匠

entries.definition: great anger
entries.definitionCN: 盛怒（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: shaped by heating and hammering metal
entries.definitionCN: 锻造的

entries.definition: shaped or beaten with a hammer
entries.definitionCN: 锤打成形的

entries.definition: made with skill and care
entries.definitionCN: 精心制作的

normalIntro.en: Wrought is work in old clothes: the past participle that a smith kept for metal and fine craft.
normalIntro.cn: wrought 就是换上旧装的 work：铁匠专门为金属与精细工艺保留的那个过去分词。

normal.en: Wrought iron is iron worked by a smith until it can be shaped.
normal.cn: wrought iron 是铁匠反复加工、变得可以塑形的铁。

normal.en: Wrought havoc means causing great destruction.
normal.cn: wrought havoc 表示造成了巨大的破坏。

normal.en: Overwrought is over plus wrought: worked up too much.
normal.cn: overwrought 是 over 加 wrought：被搅动得过了头，即过度紧张。

normal.en: Finely wrought describes writing or art made with great care.
normal.cn: finely wrought 形容文字或艺术品打磨得极为精细。

normal.en: Compare wright, the old word for a maker: both come from the same work family.
normal.cn: 对比 wright（古语「匠人」）：两者都出自 work 词族。

abstract.en: Picture a blacksmith lifting a glowing bar and hammering it flat.
abstract.cn: 想象铁匠夹起烧红的铁条，一锤一锤把它打扁。

abstract.en: See a craftsman turning a rough block into a smooth handle.
abstract.cn: 想象工匠把粗糙的木块磨成光滑的把手。

abstract.en: Imagine a writer hammering a sentence until every word clicks into place.
abstract.cn: 想象作家反复推敲一个句子，直到每个词都恰到好处。

examples.en: The gate was made of wrought iron twisted into vines.
examples.cn: 那扇门由锻铁扭成藤蔓的形状。

examples.en: Heavy rain wrought havoc on the harvest that year.
examples.cn: 那年的大雨给收成造成了严重破坏。

examples.en: She wrote a finely wrought short story.
examples.cn: 她写了一篇打磨精细的短篇小说。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肉特」——烧红的铁被锤成「肉」般柔软再成形，就是锻造；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 wyrcan（做工、制造）→ 过去分词 worht/geworht → 中古英语 wrought → 现代英语 wrought；与 wright（匠人）同出 work 词族，核心义「被做出形状」。

sensesIntro.en: Wrought begins as the old past participle of work, then narrows to hammered metal, then widens to anything carefully made or brought about.
sensesIntro.cn: wrought 原本是 work 的古过去分词，后来先收窄到锤打的金属，再扩展到精心制作之物和引发的结果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: red-hot iron hammered into shape under the smith hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：烧红的铁在铁匠手下被锤打成形。

branches.en: Worked metal is the everyday sense of wrought iron.
branches.cn: 被加工的金属是 wrought iron 的日常义项。

branches.en: Anything produced by effort is made in the broad sense of worked.
branches.cn: 凡经努力产出之物，都在「被做工」的宽泛意义上属于制造。

branches.en: When care shapes the work, the result is finely wrought.
branches.cn: 当用心参与造型，结果就是精工细作。

branches.en: A result worked into being is a result caused or brought about.
branches.cn: 被「做」出来的结果就是被引起、被造成的结果。

branches.en: The metal sense and the old participle sense share one origin in the verb work.
branches.cn: 金属义与古老分词义同出于动词 work 这一个源头。

intro.en: Wrought is not made of visible prefixes or suffixes but is the old participle of work, with compounds such as wrought-up and overwrought built on it.
intro.cn: wrought 并非由明显的前后缀构成，而是 work 的古老分词，围绕它构成了 wrought-up 与 overwrought 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin cognate for wrought; its only root is the Germanic verb work.
latinIntro.cn: wrought 没有拉丁语同源词，它的唯一词根是日耳曼语的 work。

items.meaning: to do labour or to make
items.example: Work is the verb behind wrought.
items.exampleCN: work 是 wrought 背后的动词。

items.example: Wrought is the participle form.
items.exampleCN: wrought 是过去分词形式。

items.example: Worked replaced wrought in general use.
items.exampleCN: worked 在一般用法中取代了 wrought。

items.meaningCN: 制造者（词根或构词成分）
items.example: The suffix -wright names a maker.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 -wright 表示制作者。

items.example: The prefix over- forms overwrought.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 over- 构成 overwrought。

items.example: Overwrought describes nerves worked too hard.
items.exampleCN: overwrought 形容神经被过度搅动。

items.meaningCN: 表示「已被做成」的古分词词尾
items.example: The old ending -en survives in broken and spoken.
items.exampleCN: 古词尾 -en 仍见于 broken 与 spoken 中。

items.example: The prefix in- forms inwrought.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 构成 inwrought。

definition_zh: 排外的；仇外的；对外国人或陌生群体怀有恐惧与敌意的
definition_en: showing dislike or fear of people from other countries or of people who seem foreign
core_image: 门内的人紧张地盯着门外那张陌生的新面孔
scene: 社区会议上，有人提议把新来的移民家庭赶走，理由是「他们不属于这里」。Some voters backed a xenophobic party that promised to close the borders.
sceneCN: 这里 xenophobic 是「排外的、仇外的」（第 1 个义项：对外国人的敌意）；句意：一些选民支持了一个主张关闭边境的排外政党。

derivatives.zh: xeno-（陌生）+ -phobia（恐惧），义为「排外、仇外」
xeno- + -phobe（恐惧者），义为「排外的人」
xenophobic + -ally，义为「以排外的方式」

senses.title: Hostile to people from other countries
senses.definition: showing dislike, fear, or hostility towards people of other nationalities, especially immigrants
senses.definitionCN: 对其他国家的人、尤其是移民表现出反感、恐惧或敌意
senses.example: The paper ran a xenophobic headline about the arrivals.
senses.exampleCN: 那家报纸就难民到来登了一则仇外标题。
senses.why: Xeno- means the stranger and -phobic means fearful, so the word literally names fear of the foreigner.
senses.whyCN: xeno- 意为陌生人，-phobic 意为恐惧，这个词字面上就是「对异乡人的恐惧」。

senses.title: Afraid of what seems foreign
senses.titleCN: 恐外的；畏惧陌生事物的
senses.definition: afraid or suspicious of people or things that seem foreign or unlike your own group
senses.definitionCN: 对看起来陌生或与自己群体不同的人或事物感到害怕、怀疑
senses.example: Some of the fear is xenophobic rather than based on facts.
senses.exampleCN: 其中有些恐惧是恐外心理，而非基于事实。
senses.why: The fear need not be hatred; simple discomfort with the unfamiliar is enough for the fear half of the word to show.
senses.whyCN: 这种恐惧未必是仇恨，仅仅对陌生感到不适，就足以体现这个词中「恐惧」的那一半。

senses.title: Marked by prejudice against newcomers
senses.titleCN: 带偏见的；瞧不起外来者的
senses.definition: expressing prejudice or unfair treatment towards newcomers or minorities
senses.definitionCN: 表现出对新来者或少数群体的偏见与不公平对待
senses.example: Critics called the hiring rules xenophobic and unfair.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者称这些招聘规定排外且不公平。
senses.why: When fear of the stranger turns into a fixed attitude towards those who arrive later, it becomes prejudice with a name.
senses.whyCN: 当对陌生人的恐惧固化为对后来者的一贯态度，就变成了有名字可称的偏见。

intro.en: Xenophobic joins the Greek roots xeno-, meaning stranger, to -phobic, meaning fearful, with the whole word coined in English.
intro.cn: xenophobic 把希腊词根 xeno-（陌生人）与 -phobic（恐惧）拼在一起，整个词是在英语中构造出来的。

items.en: Xenos means a stranger or guest, and phobos means fear.
items.cn: 希腊语 xenos 意为陌生人、客人，phobos 意为恐惧。

items.en: The noun xenophobie appears in French before English picks the idea up.
items.cn: 名词 xenophobie 先出现在法语中，英语随后移植了这一概念。

items.en: English forms the noun xenophobia from the Greek roots.
items.cn: 英语用这两个希腊词根造出名词 xenophobia。

items.en: The adjective xenophobic is formed by adding the -phobic ending to xeno-.
items.cn: 形容词 xenophobic 由 xeno- 加上 -phobic 词尾构成。

items.en: Since the late twentieth century the word is common in debates about migration and borders.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期以来，这个词在移民与边境议题的讨论中十分常见。

note.en: Xenophobic is built from xeno- and -phobic, and sits near prejudice, racist, and hostile in meaning.
note.cn: xenophobic 由 xeno- 与 -phobic 组合而成，含义上靠近 prejudice、racist 与 hostile 等词。

entries.definition: dislike or fear of people from other countries
entries.definitionCN: 排外；仇外

entries.definition: a person who dislikes foreigners
entries.definitionCN: 排外的人

entries.definition: a person who is attracted to foreign people and things
entries.definitionCN: 喜爱外国人和异国事物的人

entries.definition: a heavy colourless gas used in lamps
entries.definitionCN: 氙气（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: having an unfair opinion formed before knowing the facts
entries.definitionCN: 有偏见的

entries.definition: showing hatred or unfair treatment based on race
entries.definitionCN: 种族主义的

entries.definition: showing exaggerated pride in your own country or group
entries.definitionCN: 沙文主义的；狂热的

normalIntro.en: Xenophobic is a join of two Greek roots: xeno- for the stranger, -phobic for the fear.
normalIntro.cn: xenophobic 是两个希腊词根的拼接：xeno- 是陌生人，-phobic 是恐惧。

normal.en: The noun xenophobia keeps the same roots and names the attitude itself.
normal.cn: 名词 xenophobia 由同样的词根构成，指这种态度本身。

normal.en: A xenophobe is a person, formed with the -phobe ending for a fearful one.
normal.cn: xenophobe 指人，用 -phobe 词尾表示「心怀恐惧者」。

normal.en: The opposite root is in xenophile, formed with -phile for a lover of the foreign.
normal.cn: 反向词根见于 xenophile，用 -phile 表示喜爱异国事物的人。

normal.en: The same -phobic ending appears in claustrophobic, a fear of enclosed spaces.
normal.cn: 同一个 -phobic 词尾也见于 claustrophobic，即对封闭空间的恐惧。

normal.en: Xenophobic rhetoric is a common collocation in news about migration.
normal.cn: xenophobic rhetoric（仇外言论）是关于移民的新闻中的常见搭配。

abstract.en: Picture a gate where the people inside flinch at every new face outside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，门内的人对门外每一张新面孔都紧张退缩。

abstract.en: Imagine a stranger knocking and the door chain being pulled tight.
abstract.cn: 想象陌生人敲门，门链被拉得紧紧的。

abstract.en: See a crowd sorting faces into us and them before a single word is spoken.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人还没听见一句话，就先把面孔分成「我们」和「他们」。

examples.en: The speech was criticised as xenophobic by several rights groups.
examples.cn: 这篇演讲被多个维权组织批评为仇外。

examples.en: Rising xenophobic feeling made many families reluctant to move.
examples.cn: 日益高涨的排外情绪让许多家庭不愿搬迁。

examples.en: He lost his job after posting xenophobic remarks online.
examples.cn: 他在网上发表仇外言论后丢了工作。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贼懦」——见到外乡人就「贼懦」，躲着害怕，就是排外；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 xenos（陌生人、客）→ 英语词根 xeno-（外来的）+ -phobia（恐惧）→ xenophobia（排外）→ xenophobic（排外的），核心义「对异乡人的恐惧」。

sensesIntro.en: Xenophobic starts from fear of the stranger, then widens to general discomfort with the foreign and to open prejudice against newcomers.
sensesIntro.cn: xenophobic 从对陌生人的恐惧出发，先扩展到对异乡事物的普遍不适，再扩展到对新来者的公开偏见。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people behind a shut door staring warily at a stranger.
core.cn: 核心意象：门内的人警惕地盯着门外的陌生人。

branches.en: Hostility to foreigners is the main modern use.
branches.cn: 对外国人的敌意是这个词的现代主要用法。

branches.en: Plain fear of the unfamiliar keeps the -phobic half visible.
branches.cn: 对陌生事物的单纯恐惧让 -phobic 这一半清晰可见。

branches.en: Prejudice against newcomers is fear hardened into social attitude.
branches.cn: 对新来者的偏见是恐惧固化为社会态度。

branches.en: A xenophobic policy and a xenophobic remark both express the same prejudice.
branches.cn: 排外政策与仇外言论表达的是同一种偏见。

branches.en: Suspicion turns into prejudice when it governs how people treat each other.
branches.cn: 怀疑一旦支配人与人之间的对待方式，就变成了偏见。

intro.en: Xenophobic is a learned English compound of a Greek prefix and a Greek-derived suffix, with the family noun, person, and adverb beside it.
intro.cn: xenophobic 是希腊前缀加希腊来源词尾构成的英语学术词，旁边还有同族的排外名词、人和副词。

latinIntro.en: The roots are Greek, not Latin, so there is no Latin etymology to follow here.
latinIntro.cn: 这些词根来自希腊语而非拉丁语，因此这里没有拉丁语词源可讲。

items.example: The prefix xeno- marks the foreigner.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 xeno- 标识「外来者」。

items.example: The suffix -phobic adds the idea of fear.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -phobic 加入恐惧之意。

items.example: The noun ending -phobia names the fear itself.
items.exampleCN: 名词词尾 -phobia 指向恐惧本身。

items.example: The suffix -phobe names the person.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -phobe 指人。

items.example: The suffix -phile is the opposite of -phobe.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -phile 与 -phobe 相反。

items.example: The suffix -ic turns the noun into the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ic 把名词变成形容词。

items.example: The suffix -ally forms the adverb xenophobically.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ally 构成副词 xenophobically。

items.example: Claustrophobic shares the -phobic ending.
items.exampleCN: claustrophobic 共用 -phobic 词尾。

items.example: Homophobic is built the same way with a different prefix.
items.exampleCN: homophobic 用同样的造词方式换个前缀。

definition_zh: 游艇；帆船；乘游艇出游
definition_en: a medium-sized sailing boat or motor boat used for racing or for pleasure
core_image: 白帆贴着蓝海面滑行，船尾挂着一条长长的白色浪花
scene: 夏日港口排满白色船身，桅杆的影子一直伸到木栈道上。They spent the whole afternoon on a small yacht off the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 yacht 是「游艇」（第 1 个义项：供休闲或竞赛的中型帆船或机动艇）；句意：他们在港口旁的一艘小游艇上待了一整个下午。

derivatives.zh: yacht + -ing，义为「帆船运动、乘游艇出游」
yacht + -s + man，义为「驾驶游艇或帆船的人」
yacht + -s + woman，义为「女帆船爱好者」

senses.title: A boat for pleasure or racing
senses.definition: a medium-sized sailing or motor boat kept for pleasure, cruising, or racing
senses.definitionCN: 供休闲、巡航或比赛用的中型帆船或机动艇
senses.example: We rented a yacht for the weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 我们租了一艘游艇过周末。
senses.why: The word came from Dutch jacht, meaning a fast hunting boat, and English kept that fast pleasure craft as yacht.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自荷兰语 jacht，意为「快速的狩猎船」，英语把这种快捷的休闲小船称为 yacht。

senses.title: A large ship of the wealthy
senses.definition: a large, expensive private boat owned by a wealthy person
senses.definitionCN: 富人拥有的昂贵私人船艇
senses.example: His yacht is long enough to carry a helicopter.
senses.exampleCN: 他的游艇长得可以载一架直升机。
senses.why: Because jacht was a swift ship of war and shooting, the word long carried a tone of luxury and high status.
senses.whyCN: 由于 jacht 曾是迅捷的战争与狩猎用船，这个词长期带着奢侈与高身份的色彩。

senses.title: To cruise in a yacht
senses.definition: to sail or travel in a yacht
senses.definitionCN: 乘游艇航行或出游
senses.example: They yachted along the coast of Italy all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 他们整个夏天都在意大利海岸驾艇航行。
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb by the usual English habit of using a boat name for the activity it supports.
senses.whyCN: 名词按英语常见的用法转为动词：用船的名字代表乘这条船进行的活动。

intro.en: Yacht comes from Dutch jacht, a fast boat for chasing, first borrowed into English in the sixteenth century.
intro.cn: yacht 来自荷兰语 jacht，即「用于追逐的快速小船」，十六世纪借入英语。

items.en: The root jagen means to hunt or chase, and the boat name comes from that verb.
items.cn: 词根 jagen 意为狩猎、追逐，船名即来自这个动词。

items.en: jacht is a swift sturdy vessel used to chase pirates or for shooting.
items.cn: jacht 是一种用来追击海盗或狩猎的快速坚固船只。

items.en: English borrows the word during its wars with Spain and spells it yaght or yacht.
items.cn: 英语在与西班牙交战期间借入此词，拼作 yaght 或 yacht。

items.en: The spelling settles as yacht, and the boat becomes one for pleasure and racing.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 yacht，这种船也转为休闲与竞赛之用。

items.en: Yacht now ranges from small racing boats to very large luxury cruisers.
items.cn: 如今 yacht 从竞赛小帆船到大型豪华游艇都可指称。

note.en: Yacht sits inside the boat family, near boat, sailboat, and the verb yachting.
note.cn: yacht 属于船的义场，靠近 boat、sailboat 以及航海动词 yachting。

entries.definition: the activity of sailing or cruising in a yacht
entries.definitionCN: 帆船运动；乘游艇出游

entries.definition: a person who sails a yacht
entries.definitionCN: 驾驶帆船的人

entries.definition: a thick sour milk food
entries.definitionCN: 酸奶（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a unit of length or an enclosed area
entries.definitionCN: 码；院子（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: a small vessel for travel on water
entries.definitionCN: 小船

entries.definition: a sailing boat with two masts
entries.definitionCN: 双桅帆船

entries.definition: a motor boat used for cruising
entries.definitionCN: 巡游艇

normalIntro.en: Yacht is a Dutch gift to English: a fast chasing boat that became a pleasure craft.
normalIntro.cn: yacht 是荷兰语送给英语的词：一种用来追逐的快船，最后成了休闲船。

normal.en: A yacht club is both a place and a social group of boat owners.
normal.cn: yacht club 既是场所，也是一群船主的社交团体。

normal.en: Yachting names the sport, formed from yacht with -ing.
normal.cn: yachting 是这项运动的名称，由 yacht 加 -ing 构成。

normal.en: A yachtsman sails or races a yacht for pleasure.
normal.cn: yachtsman 指以驾驶帆船、游艇为乐的人。

normal.en: Sailing yacht points to the sail and wind, while luxury yacht points to the money.
normal.cn: sailing yacht 强调风帆，luxury yacht 强调金钱。

normal.en: Dutch jacht meant hunt, so a yacht was once a boat that chased things.
normal.cn: 荷兰语 jacht 本是「打猎」，所以 yacht 最初是「追逐猎物」的船。

abstract.en: Picture a white sail cutting a long line across a blue bay.
abstract.cn: 想象白帆在蓝色海湾上划出一道长长的白线。

abstract.en: Imagine rope rubbing on wood while the yacht leans into the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象游艇迎风倾斜，绳索在木板上磨出的吱声。

abstract.en: See a party of friends waving from the deck as the yacht pulls away.
abstract.cn: 想象一群朋友站在甲板上挥手，游艇渐渐驶离。

examples.en: The yacht club holds a race every weekend in summer.
examples.cn: 游艇俱乐部夏天每个周末都举办比赛。

examples.en: A fleet of yachts gathered near the island.
examples.cn: 一队游艇聚集在岛屿附近。

examples.en: They yachted from port to port along the coast.
examples.cn: 他们沿着海岸从一个港口驾艇到另一个港口。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「约特」——约上一群朋友去海上特别出游，坐的就是 yacht；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 西日耳曼语 jagen（狩猎、追逐）→ 荷兰语 jacht（疾驰的狩猎船）→ 英语借入 yacht（游艇、帆船），核心义「为追逐而造的快速小船」，后来转为休闲与竞赛。

sensesIntro.en: Yacht starts as a fast boat for chasing, settles as a pleasure and racing boat, then splits into the expensive cruiser and the verb for cruising.
sensesIntro.cn: yacht 原是用于追逐的快船，后定为休闲与竞赛用船，再分出昂贵的豪华游艇和乘艇出游的动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white sail leaning into the wind over blue water.
core.cn: 核心意象：白帆迎风倾斜，掠过碧蓝海面。

branches.en: The pleasure and racing boat is the general sense.
branches.cn: 休闲与竞赛用船是这个词的一般义项。

branches.en: The large private yacht shows the luxury side of the word.
branches.cn: 大型私人游艇体现了这个词的奢华一面。

branches.en: The verb turns the boat into a way of travelling.
branches.cn: 动词用法把船变成一种出行方式。

branches.en: Small racing yacht and huge luxury yacht share the same fast-boat origin.
branches.cn: 竞赛小帆船与豪华大游艇共享同一个「快船」源头。

branches.en: The noun names the boat, and the verb names what people do with it.
branches.cn: 名词指船本身，动词指人们用这种船所做的事。

intro.en: Yacht is a Dutch loanword rather than a Latin compound, and English builds yachting, yachtsman, and yachtswoman on it.
intro.cn: yacht 是荷兰语借词而非拉丁语复合词，英语在它基础上构成 yachting、yachtsman 与 yachtswoman。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root behind yacht; the boat name is of Dutch origin and only loosely related to Latin hunting words.
latinIntro.cn: yacht 背后没有拉丁语词根；船名源自荷兰语，仅与拉丁语狩猎类词有松散的远亲关系。

items.example: The Dutch jacht is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 荷兰语 jacht 是直接来源。

items.example: The verb jagen gives the boat its speed.
items.exampleCN: 动词 jagen 赋予这种船速度感。

items.example: Yacht keeps the sh of Dutch spelling but is said like yot.
items.exampleCN: yacht 保留了荷兰式拼写的 ch，却读如 yot。

items.example: The plural ending -s forms yachts.
items.exampleCN: 复数词尾 -s 构成 yachts。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms yachting.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 yachting。

items.example: The suffix -man forms yachtsman.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -man 构成 yachtsman。

items.example: The suffix -woman forms yachtswoman.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -woman 构成 yachtswoman。

items.example: The ending -ed forms yachted.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 yachted。

items.example: Yachts crowd the marina in August.
items.exampleCN: 八月里游艇挤满了码头。

definition_zh: 牦牛；闲扯；喋喋不休地说；闲谈
definition_en: a large shaggy-haired ox of the high plateaus of Asia, or to talk at length about unimportant things
core_image: 披着长毛的牦牛站在积雪高原上，一开口就是停不下来的闲话
scene: 游客站在海拔四千米的高原上，第一次近距离看见这种长毛大牛。On the high plateau the visitor finally saw a shaggy yak standing in the snow.
sceneCN: 这里 yak 是「牦牛」（第 1 个义项：亚洲高原上的长毛牛）；句意：在高原上，游客终于看见一头披着长毛的牦牛站在雪中。

pos.zh: 牦牛（亚洲高原上的长毛牛）
闲扯；喋喋不休地说（非正式）

derivatives.zh: 基础动词加 -er 构成，指「絮絮叨叨的人」（非正式）
基础动词加 -y 构成，指「话多闲扯的」（非正式）
现在分词作名词用，指「闲聊、絮叨」

senses.title: A long-haired ox of the Asian highlands
senses.definition: a large wild or domestic ox with very long hair, found on the high plateaus of Tibet and the Himalayas
senses.definitionCN: 生活在青藏高原和喜马拉雅高海拔地区的长毛牛，有野生也有家养
senses.example: Yaks are the main pack animals on the Tibetan plateau.
senses.exampleCN: 牦牛是青藏高原上的主要驮畜。
senses.why: The Tibetan word names the animal itself; this is the oldest and most concrete sense in English.
senses.whyCN: 这个词直接借用藏语中对这种动物的称呼，是英语里最古老、最具体的义项。

senses.title: A yak as a product and a symbol
senses.definition: the meat, hair, leather, or butter of a yak, which local people use as food and clothing
senses.definitionCN: 牦牛的肉、毛、皮或奶制成的黄油，是当地人的食物和衣物原料
senses.example: Warm socks made of yak wool keep feet dry.
senses.exampleCN: 牦牛毛做的厚袜子能让脚保持干爽。
senses.why: Once the word named the animal, it naturally fronted compounds for everything taken from it, such as wool and butter.
senses.whyCN: 词只先指动物本身，随后便顺理成章地前置构成表示「取自它的东西」的复合词，如毛与酥油。

senses.title: To chatter at length
senses.definition: to talk continuously and often about unimportant matters, cheekily or casually
senses.definitionCN: 不停地闲聊，多谈琐碎小事，语气随意或略带厚脸皮
senses.example: They yakked about the match until midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 他们东拉西扯地聊比赛，聊到半夜。
senses.why: This sense comes from a different source, the back slang yack, and has nothing to do with the skin of the animal.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项另有来源，来自英语俚语 yack（反切俚语），与牦牛的皮毫无关系，只是在拼写上撞了名。

senses.title: To raise dull complaints and remarks
senses.definition: to keep making long, boring, or complaining remarks about the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 对同一件事反复发表冗长、无聊或抱怨的话
senses.example: People will yak endlessly about the traffic and never change anything.
senses.exampleCN: 人们会没完没了地抱怨交通，却从不改变任何事。
senses.why: The chatter sense turns negative when the talk is repetitive and empty, so the verb can also carry a tone of dull complaint.
senses.whyCN: 当闲话变得重复而空洞，「闲扯」就带上了负面色彩，于是这个动词也能表示无聊的抱怨。

intro.en: Yak for the animal comes from Tibetan g.yag through English travelers in the late eighteenth century; yak for talking comes from an unrelated slang yack.
intro.cn: 表示动物的 yak 经由英国旅行者在十八世纪后期从藏语 g.yag 借入英语；表示「闲聊」的 yak 则来自毫无关系的俚语 yack。

items.en: The Tibetan word for the male of the species is written g.yag.
items.cn: 藏语中称呼这种动物的雄性写作 g.yag。

items.en: British travelers on the borders of China took the word into English as yak.
items.cn: 在中国边境的英国旅行者把这个词以 yak 的形式带入英语。

items.en: Yak becomes the standard English name for the whole species, male and female.
items.cn: yak 成为整个物种（雌雄皆包括）的标准英语名称。

items.en: The slang verb yack, meaning to talk idly, spreads widely, and yak is picked as its twin spelling.
items.cn: 表示「闲聊」的俚语 yack 流传开来，yak 被用作它的孪生拼写。

items.en: The two words now share one spelling, one animal and one endless chatter; the link is only visual.
items.cn: 两个词如今共用一种拼写：一个指动物，一个指无休止的闲话；联系仅停留在字形上。

note.en: Yak the animal stands next to the other highland cattle words, while its chatter sense belongs to a separate slang family.
note.cn: 表示动物的 yak 与高原牛类词汇相邻，而它的「闲聊」义项属于另一个俚语家族。

entries.definition: to chatter in a casual, repetitive way
entries.definitionCN: 絮絮叨叨地闲聊；这是闲聊动词的俚语原形拼写，与牦牛一词同音形近但来源不同

entries.definition: too fond of chattering
entries.definitionCN: 话多闲扯的；由闲聊动词加 -y 构成

entries.definition: a person who talks on and on
entries.definitionCN: 絮絮叨叨的人；由闲聊动词加 -er 构成

entries.definition: a large domestic animal used for pulling loads
entries.definitionCN: 公牛；阉牛，是牦牛的同属近亲概念

entries.definition: to talk quickly and continuously about unimportant things
entries.definitionCN: 喋喋不休；闲扯，与 yak 的闲聊义项最接近

entries.definition: a large wild ox of the forests of South Asia
entries.definitionCN: 印度野牛；南亚森林中的大型野牛，同为亚洲牛类

normalIntro.en: Yak is two words in one spelling: a hairy plateau ox and an endless chatter.
normalIntro.cn: yak 是一个拼写里的两个词：高原上的长毛牛，以及停不下来的闲话。

normal.en: A yak is a shaggy ox that lives where the air is thin.
normal.cn: yak 是生活在空气稀薄之地、披着长毛的牛。

normal.en: Yak wool and yak butter are both taken from the same animal.
normal.cn: 牦牛毛和酥油都取自同一种动物。

normal.en: To yak is to talk on and on about small things.
normal.cn: 动词 yak 指对着小事说个没完。

normal.en: Yak away and yak about are common phrasal shapes of the verb.
normal.cn: yak away 与 yak about 是这个动词常见的短语形态。

normal.en: Compare yack: the slang spelling records the chattering sense, while yak records the animal.
normal.cn: 对比 yack：俚语拼写记录「闲扯」义，yak 记录「动物」义。

abstract.en: Picture a thick coat of hair swaying as the animal climbs a cold pass.
abstract.cn: 想象动物走上寒冷山口时，厚厚的长毛左右摆动。

abstract.en: Imagine a cup of tea with a spoonful of golden butter on top.
abstract.cn: 想象一杯茶，上面浮着一勺金黄的黄油。

abstract.en: See in your mind two people talking by a fire long after the tea is cold.
abstract.cn: 在脑中想象两个人在火边说话，茶凉了很久还没停。

examples.en: The yak carries loads across the mountain passes.
examples.cn: 牦牛驮着货物翻越山口。

examples.en: She bought a scarf of soft yak wool in Lhasa.
examples.cn: 她在拉萨买了一条柔软的牦牛毛围巾。

examples.en: We yakked about old school days all evening.
examples.cn: 我们整个晚上都在东拉西扯地聊学生时代。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「雅克」——想起衣领上那圈蓬松毛领，像牦牛的长毛；这只是谐音联想，与藏语来源无关。

root: 词源分两支：表动物的 yak 直接借自藏语 g.yag（十八世纪后期经旅行者进入英语）；表「闲扯」的 yak 来自英语俚语 yack，与牦牛无关，二者只是同音同形。

sensesIntro.en: Yak begins with the concrete animal on the roof of the world, extends to everything taken from it, and then jumps to a separate slang verb for endless talk and dull complaint.
sensesIntro.cn: yak 先从世界屋脊上那头具体的牛说起，再扩展到取自它的毛、肉与酥油，最后跳到另一个俚语动词，表示无休止的闲话与无聊的抱怨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shaggy ox in the thin air of a snowy plateau.
core.cn: 核心意象：雪域高原稀薄空气中一头披着长毛的牛。

branches.en: The concrete animal borrowed from Tibetan is the base sense.
branches.cn: 借自藏语的具体动物名是基础义项。

branches.en: Products made from the animal front the word in compounds.
branches.cn: 取自这头动物的制品常以它为前缀构成复合词。

branches.en: The slang verb for chatting is a homograph of a different origin.
branches.cn: 表示闲聊的动词是同形异源的俚语。

branches.en: Repeated empty talk shades into complaining.
branches.cn: 重复的空话进一步滑向抱怨。

branches.en: The living animal and its wool or butter belong to one Highland life.
branches.cn: 活着的牦牛与它的毛、酥油同属一种高原生活。

intro.en: Yak has almost no derivational power, apart from slang -er and -y; both spellings of this word are borrowings rather than affixed forms.
intro.cn: yak 的派生能力很弱，除了俚语后缀 -er 与 -y 几乎不构新词；这个词的两种拼写都是借词，都不是加缀形成的。

latinIntro.en: Latin has no part in yak; the animal name comes from Tibetan, and the chatter verb comes from English slang.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语与 yak 无关：动物名来自藏语，闲聊动词来自英语俚语。

items.meaning: the male of the long-haired ox
items.example: The Tibetan form g.yag is the direct source of the English noun.
items.exampleCN: 藏语形式 g.yag 是英语名词的直接来源。

items.example: Yack is the slang base behind the chatter sense.
items.exampleCN: yack 是「闲扯」义项背后的俚语基础。

items.example: Yak keeps the animal meaning in English.
items.exampleCN: yak 在英语中保留动物含义。

items.example: The verb yak is written with one k in both spellings.
items.exampleCN: 动词 yak 的两种拼写都只有一个 k。

items.meaningCN: 复数或第三人称单数标记
items.example: The suffix -s forms yaks for both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -s 同时构成 yaks 的复数与三单。

items.meaningCN: 过去式或过去分词标记
items.example: The suffix -ed forms yakked with a doubled k.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 构成 yakked，其中的 k 需双写。

items.example: The suffix -ing forms yakking with a doubled k.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 构成 yakking，其中的 k 需双写。

items.example: The suffix -er forms yakker, a slang word for a chatterer.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -er 构成 yakker，是「话痨」的俚语说法。

items.example: The suffix -y forms the slang adjective yakky.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -y 构成俚语形容词 yakky。

definition_zh: 渴望；向往；思念；苦恋
definition_en: to feel a strong, often sad and sustained wish or love for something you do not have
core_image: 一个人伸手朝向远处，掌心里却空无一物
scene: 离开故乡多年的人常在夜里想起老家。She often yearns for the quiet streets of her hometown far away.
sceneCN: 这里 yearn 是「思念、渴望」（第 1 个义项：对得不到之人或物久久惦念）；句意：她常常思念远方故乡那些安静的街道。

pos.zh: 渴望；思念；向往（常与 for 或 after 连用）

collocations.zh: 渴望某事物；思念某事物

derivatives.zh: 基础词加古英语名词后缀 -ing 构成，指「渴望；思念」
由名词 yearning 加 -ly 构成，指「饱含渴望地」
基础词加 -er 构成，指「渴望者」（较少用）

senses.title: To long deeply for something
senses.definition: to feel a strong, steady wish for something good or desirable that you do not yet have
senses.definitionCN: 对尚未拥有的美好事物怀有强烈而持久的愿望
senses.example: For years she yearned for a place of her own.
senses.exampleCN: 多年来她一直渴望有一个属于自己的地方。
senses.why: The oldest English sense is a burning eagerness, the picture of a person reaching out for what is missing.
senses.whyCN: 英语中最古老的用法就是火热的急切之心，正是伸手去够那缺失之物的画面。

senses.title: To miss an absent person or place
senses.definition: to miss someone or somewhere so much that the absence becomes a constant ache
senses.definitionCN: 极其想念某人或某地，缺失感变成一种持续的隐痛
senses.example: The old man yearned for the valleys of his childhood.
senses.exampleCN: 老人怀念童年的山谷。
senses.why: If the desired thing is a person or a home already known, the wish turns into missing and homesickness.
senses.whyCN: 当渴望的对象是已经认识的人或家，愿望就转为思念和乡愁。

senses.title: To long for love or tenderness
senses.definition: to feel a strong need for affection, comfort, or emotional closeness
senses.definitionCN: 对关爱、安慰或情感亲近有强烈的需要
senses.example: The child yearned for a kind word from her father.
senses.exampleCN: 那孩子渴望父亲的一句温言。
senses.why: The emotion is first applied to warm human feeling, and only later to ideas of freedom or success.
senses.whyCN: 这一情感最初用于人的温暖感受，后来才扩展到自由、成功等抽象目标。

senses.title: To be moved with compassion
senses.definition: to feel deep pity and softness towards someone who is suffering
senses.definitionCN: 对受苦之人怀有深切怜悯与柔软之情
senses.example: Those who saw the refugees yearned over their hardship.
senses.exampleCN: 见到难民的人为他们的苦难而心痛。
senses.why: An early English use pointed the intense feeling outward, so longing became tender pity for another.
senses.whyCN: 早期英语把这种强烈情感朝外指，于是「渴望」也演变为对他人的怜惜。

senses.title: To strive after something eagerly
senses.definition: to work and strive eagerly towards a goal that matters very much
senses.definitionCN: 为非常看重的目标热切地努力与争取
senses.example: Young architects yearn to build something lasting.
senses.exampleCN: 年轻的建筑师渴望建成能长久留存的东西。
senses.why: When the wish meets action, yearning turns into pursuit and effort.
senses.whyCN: 当愿望落到行动上，渴望就变成了追求与努力。

intro.en: Yearn goes back to Old English giernan, to desire, from a Germanic root meaning eager, which also gives the modern adjective eager.
intro.cn: yearn 可追溯到古英语 giernan（渴望），源出意为「急切的」的日耳曼语词根，现代形容词 eager 也来自同一词根。

items.en: A reconstructed root meaning eager or eager to go lies behind the word.
items.cn: 该词背后有一个重构词根，意为「急切的」或「急于前行」。

items.en: The verb giernan means to desire or to strive after something.
items.cn: 古英语动词 giernan 意为渴望或努力追求。

items.en: In early religious writing the verb also means to yearn over someone, that is, to pity them.
items.cn: 在早期宗教文本中，该动词还表示 yearn over 某人，即怜悯某人。

items.en: The spelling shifts towards yearnen, and the emotional tone deepens.
items.cn: 拼写逐渐演变为 yearnen，情感色彩也随之加深。

items.en: Yearn settles into the steady longing that dominates its use today.
items.cn: yearn 定型为现代英语中占主导地位的「持久向往」之义。

note.en: Yearn is the long, aching version of wishing, sharing a Germanic root with eager and standing next to want, long, and pine.
note.cn: yearn 是「愿望」中绵长而带痛感的那一类，与 eager 同源，并与 want、long、pine 相邻。

entries.definition: very keen to do or have something
entries.definitionCN: 热切的；由同一个日耳曼词根「急切」而来，与 yearn 同源

entries.definition: a strong feeling of longing
entries.definitionCN: 渴望；思念，由 yearn 加 -ing 构成的名词

entries.definition: to receive money in return for work
entries.definitionCN: 挣得；赚得，只是拼写相近、词源不同，来自与 yearn 无关的日耳曼词

entries.definition: to want something very much, especially over a long time
entries.definitionCN: 渴望，尤指长期盼望；是 yearn 最接近的同义词

entries.definition: to suffer with longing for someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 为思念而憔悴，带有消瘦的意味，比 yearn 更痛苦

entries.definition: to want something so strongly that you cannot settle without it
entries.definitionCN: 渴求，多用于食物或强烈欲望，强于 yearn

normalIntro.en: Yearn is the long ache of wanting: an old English verb with the same root as eager.
normalIntro.cn: yearn 是「想要」里绵长的那份隐痛：一个与 eager 同源的古老英语动词。

normal.en: Yearn for is the most common shape: you yearn for a person, a place, or a life.
normal.cn: yearn for 是最常见的结构：yearn for 某人、某地或某种生活。

normal.en: A yearner is a person whose wish never quite rests.
normal.cn: yearner 是愿望始终不能安歇的人。

normal.en: The noun yearning keeps the same emotion in a quieter, steadier form.
normal.cn: 名词 yearning 把同一种情感收成更安静、更恒定的形态。

normal.en: Because yearn shares a root with eager, both words point to a quickened, restless heart.
normal.cn: 因为 yearn 与 eager 同源，两个词都指向一颗加快、跳动不安的心。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with earn, which is about wages, not wishes.
normal.cn: 不要与 earn 混淆，后者关乎工资，而不是愿望。

abstract.en: Picture a hand stretched towards a light it cannot quite touch.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手朝一团始终差一点够到的光伸去。

abstract.en: Imagine standing at a station long after the last train has left.
abstract.cn: 想象站在车站，末班车早已开走，人却不肯离开。

abstract.en: Feel an old quilt that still smells of a childhood home.
abstract.cn: 感受一床旧被子，仍带着童年老屋的气味。

examples.en: She yearned for the warmth of her old family kitchen.
examples.cn: 她怀念老家厨房的温暖。

examples.en: After months in the city, he began to yearn for open fields.
examples.cn: 在城市待了数月后，他开始渴望开阔的原野。

examples.en: The students yearn to study under a great teacher.
examples.cn: 学生们渴望在一位大师门下求学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「夜里想」——夜深人静时最想念远方的人，于是 yearn 就是「夜想」；这只是谐音联想，与古英语来源无关。

root: 古英语 giernan（渴望、力争）→ 中古英语 yearnen → 现代英语 yearn；词根与形容词 eager 同出一源，原始日耳曼语重构形式 *gernjan，意为「急切的」。

sensesIntro.en: Yearn starts as a burning wish, turns inward towards missing and missing love, then widens towards pity, and finally towards eager striving.
sensesIntro.cn: yearn 始于炽热的愿望，转向对人与爱的思念，再扩展到对他人的怜悯，最后落到热切的争取。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching towards something just out of reach.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸向始终差一点够不到的东西。

branches.en: The plain wish for something good is the main everyday sense.
branches.cn: 对美好事物的单纯愿望是最主要的日常义项。

branches.en: Wishing for a known place or person becomes missing it.
branches.cn: 对已知的人或地方怀有愿望，就成为思念。

branches.en: Yearning for affection is the emotional core of the word.
branches.cn: 对亲情的渴望是这个词的情绪核心。

branches.en: Early texts turned the same intensity outward as pity.
branches.cn: 早期文本把同样的强度朝外指，成为怜悯。

branches.en: A wish that drives action becomes effort and pursuit.
branches.cn: 推动行动的愿望就变成了努力与追求。

intro.en: Yearn is a native Germanic verb; its endings -s, -ed, and -ing are inflectional, and the noun yearning is its main derivational form.
intro.cn: yearn 是本土日耳曼动词，其 -s、-ed、-ing 属于屈折变化，名词 yearning 是它主要的派生形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin plays no part in yearn; the word descends from Old English and has no Latin cognates in the English family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语与 yearn 无关：这个词源自中古英语之前的古英语，英语词族中没有拉丁同源词。

items.example: Old English giernan is the recorded ancestor of the modern verb.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 giernan 是现代动词有记录可查的祖先。

items.example: The root gernjan is a reconstruction, not an attested word.
items.exampleCN: 词根 gernjan 是重构形式，并非有文字记录的词。

items.example: The modern verb yearn keeps the reaching feeling.
items.exampleCN: 现代动词 yearn 保留了伸手去够的感觉。

items.example: The noun yearning is more literary than the plain wish.
items.exampleCN: 名词 yearning 比普通的愿望更具文学色彩。

items.example: The adverb yearningly marks a look or a voice full of longing.
items.exampleCN: 副词 yearningly 用来形容饱含渴望的眼神或声音。

items.example: The noun yearner is rare but regular.
items.exampleCN: 名词 yearner 少见，但构词十分规则。

items.example: The suffix -s forms yearns in the present tense.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -s 构成现在时第三人称单数 yearns。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms yearned on a regular pattern.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ed 按规则方式构成 yearned。

items.meaning: present participle or verbal noun marker
items.meaningCN: 现在分词或动名词标记
items.example: The suffix -ing gives both the participle and the noun.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ing 既构成分词，也构成名词。

items.example: The suffix -ly turns yearning into the adverb yearningly.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 把 yearning 变成副词 yearningly。

definition_zh: 日元；渴望；瘾；迷恋
definition_en: the unit of money in Japan, or a strong desire or craving for something
core_image: 一枚印着日元符号的硬币，后面跟着一双紧盯它的眼睛
scene: 东京一间小额换汇店里，柜员问客人要换成哪种货币。Could you change this into yen for me before the bank closes.
sceneCN: 这里 yen 是「日元」（第 1 个义项：日本的货币单位）；句意：银行关门前，能帮我把这笔钱换成日元吗。

pos.zh: 日元（日本货币单位，复数同形）

derivatives.zh: 由 yen 加连字符复合词构成，指「以日元计价的」
由 yen 叠加形容词 base 的 -ed 形式构成，指「以日元为基础的」
由 yen 加旧词后缀 -ware（商品、器皿）构成的仿古新闻用语，指「日本产玩具或商品」

senses.title: The basic unit of Japanese money
senses.definition: the standard unit of money in Japan, equal to one hundred sen in the old system
senses.definitionCN: 日本的标准货币单位，旧制下一日元等于一百钱
senses.example: The train ticket cost two thousand yen.
senses.exampleCN: 这张火车票花了二千日元。
senses.why: English borrowed the Japanese name of the round coin, so this is the most literal and most frequent sense.
senses.whyCN: 英语直接借用了日语对那枚圆形硬币的称呼，因此这是最本义、也最高频的义项。

senses.title: Money seen as a currency strength
senses.definition: the value of Japanese money as traded or priced against other currencies
senses.definitionCN: 日元在外汇市场上相对其他货币的币值与价格
senses.example: A strong yen makes foreign holidays cheaper for Japanese travelers.
senses.exampleCN: 日元走强让日本人出国的假期更便宜。
senses.why: Once a currency name enters finance, it names the whole unit of exchange in headlines, as in a strong or weak currency.
senses.whyCN: 货币名进入金融语域后，就代表整个交易单位，在新闻中可用「强势」或「疲弱」来形容。

senses.title: An intense longing
senses.definition: a strong, often urgent wish for something you want very much
senses.definitionCN: 对极其想要之物怀有强烈甚至急迫的愿望
senses.example: After months of study, she had a yen to see the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 苦读了几个月后，她特别想去看海。
senses.why: This sense comes from a separate source, the Cantonese word for craving, and only later met the money word in spelling.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项另有来源，来自粤语中表示「瘾、渴望」的说法 opium yen，后来才在拼写上撞入货币词。

senses.title: A habit one cannot shake
senses.definition: a craving or habit that pulls a person back again and again
senses.definitionCN: 让人一次又一次被拉回去的强烈嗜好或习惯
senses.example: He has a yen for gambling that has cost him his savings.
senses.exampleCN: 他对赌博上瘾，已因此输掉全部积蓄。
senses.why: The original craving was of smoking; that image of an addictive pull now covers any habit.
senses.whyCN: 最早的渴望原指烟瘾，那种「被拽着」的画面如今可套用在任何嗜好上。

intro.en: The money word yen is Japanese en, meaning a round object, from the Chinese root for circle, spelled with the character that also names the circle in mathematics; the wishing sense comes from Cantonese, where the same sound means opium craving.
intro.cn: 货币义 yen 来自日语 en（圆形之物），源出汉语表示「圆」的词根，所用的汉字在数学里也指圆；渴望义则借自粤语，同一读音意为鸦片瘾。

items.en: The character names something round, and later the round coin itself.
items.cn: 该汉字本指圆形之物，后指圆形的钱币。

items.en: Japan adopts the round money unit and names it en, written with the same character.
items.cn: 日本采用圆形货币单位，以同一汉字写作 en。

items.en: English speakers spell the name yen and use it for the Japanese unit.
items.cn: 英语使用者把它拼作 yen，用来称呼日本的货币单位。

items.en: Cantonese slang for an opium craving and later for any strong desire is also pronounced yen.
items.cn: 粤语中表示鸦片瘾、后泛指强烈渴望的俚语，读音也是 yen。

items.en: The two histories now share one four-letter word, money on one side and craving on the other.
items.cn: 两条历史如今共用一个四字母词形：一边指钱，一边指渴望。

note.en: Yen is a short money word that also names a craving; it sits near other currency units and near wish words.
note.cn: yen 是一个兼指「钱」与「渴望」的短词，既与其他货币单位相邻，也与表示愿望的词相邻。

entries.definition: plural of yen when it means a longing
entries.definitionCN: 渴望义时的复数形式，货币义则复数同形

entries.definition: the unit of money in China
entries.definitionCN: 人民币元；与 yen 字形相近但所指货币不同，两者的汉字传统相通而词源路径不同

entries.definition: priced in Japanese money
entries.definitionCN: 以日元计价的，是 yen 最常见的复合词搭配

entries.definition: the unit of money in South Korea
entries.definitionCN: 韩元；东南亚地区另一个以圆形钱币命名的货币单位

entries.definition: a strong feeling of longing
entries.definitionCN: 渴望；思念，与 yen 的第三个义项最为接近

entries.definition: a powerful urge for something
entries.definitionCN: 强烈欲望；瘾，与 yen 的第四个义项呼应

normalIntro.en: Yen is two short borrowings in one shape: a Japanese coin and a Cantonese craving.
normalIntro.cn: yen 是一个词形里的两次短小借入：一枚日本钱币与一份粤语里的瘾。

normal.en: The Japanese unit yen is spelled the same in the plural, so two hundred yen needs no ending.
normal.cn: 日语货币单位 yen 的复数同形，所以二百日元不必加词尾。

normal.en: In finance writing yen pairs with strong and weak.
normal.cn: 在财经文章中，yen 常与「强势」和「疲弱」搭配。

normal.en: Have a yen for means to want something badly.
normal.cn: 「have a yen for」表示非常想要某物。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with yuan, which is a different currency with a similar sound.
normal.cn: 不要与 yuan 混淆，那是另一种货币，读音相近而已。

normal.en: Compare yen with the longer word yearning: both describe longing, but yen is everyday and casual.
normal.cn: 对比更长的 yearning：二者同表渴望，但 yen 更日常随意。

abstract.en: Picture a coin with a hole in the middle lying on a shop counter.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚中间带孔的硬币躺在商店柜台上。

abstract.en: Imagine a traveller checking a currency board before buying a ticket.
abstract.cn: 想象旅客买票前先看一眼汇率牌。

abstract.en: See someone staring at a menu with a sudden fierce appetite.
abstract.cn: 想象有人盯着菜单，忽然冒出一股强烈的食欲。

examples.en: She exchanged her savings into yen at the airport.
examples.cn: 她在机场把存款换成了日元。

examples.en: The trip cost him about fifty thousand yen in total.
examples.cn: 这趟旅行总共花了他大约五万日元。

examples.en: After months indoors, he had a yen for open water.
examples.cn: 在室内待了几个月后，他特别想看到开阔的水面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「眼」——眼睛一盯上那枚钱币，就生出「瘾」；同一个音既指钱又指渴望，是巧合般的双关，并非词源真相。

root: 两条平行起源：货币义来自日语 en（源自汉语「圆」义的圆钱单位），英语拼作 yen；渴望义借自粤语俚语表示鸦片瘾、后泛指渴求的读音，同样写作 yen。二者同形但不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Yen starts with Japanese money, moves into money as a traded value, and then, from a separate Cantonese source, covers longing and addictive craving.
sensesIntro.cn: yen 从日本货币说起，转而言货币作为交易币值，最后经由另一条粤语来源，涵盖渴求与戒不掉的瘾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round coin that draws a hungry stare.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚圆硬币引来一双饥渴的目光。

branches.en: The coin itself is the base everyday sense.
branches.cn: 硬币本身是最基础的日常义项。

branches.en: Money as a traded value is the financial sense.
branches.cn: 作为交易币值是金融语域的义项。

branches.en: The longing sense comes from a separate Cantonese word.
branches.cn: 渴望义项来自另一个粤语词。

branches.en: An addictive pull is the darker extension of craving.
branches.cn: 戒不掉的瘾是热切渴求更深沉、更沉溺的一面。

branches.en: The coin and the currency rate belong to the same money world.
branches.cn: 硬币与汇率同属货币世界。

intro.en: Yen is a bare borrowing with no affixes of its own; its only productive shapes are the compound yen-denominated and occasional plurals.
intro.cn: yen 是不带任何词缀的纯借词，它仅有的能产形态是以它构成的复合词（如日元计价）以及偶尔出现的一般复数。

latinIntro.en: Latin plays no part in yen; the word travels through Japanese and Cantonese and has no Latin cognates.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语与 yen 无关：这个词经由日语与粤语传入，没有拉丁同源词。

items.meaning: a round coin, the money unit
items.example: The Japanese form en is written with the character for a circle.
items.exampleCN: 日语形式 en 用一个表示「圆」的汉字书写。

items.example: Chinese yuan shares the circle tradition behind the word family.
items.exampleCN: 人民币元与这一词族背后「圆」的传统相通。

items.example: English yen names the unit it borrowed.
items.exampleCN: 英语 yen 指它借入的货币单位。

items.example: The plural yens appears only in the longing sense.
items.exampleCN: 复数 yens 只出现在渴望义中。

items.example: Banks issue yen-denominated bonds for global buyers.
items.exampleCN: 银行为全球买家发行以日元计价的债券。

items.example: The fund follows a yen-based index.
items.exampleCN: 该基金跟踪一个以日元为基础的指数。

items.example: Yenware echoed the old use of -ware for goods.
items.exampleCN: yenware 沿用了旧后缀 -ware 表示商品的用法。

items.example: The suffix -s gives yens in the craving sense.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -s 在渴望义中构成 yens。

definition_zh: 热情；热忱；干劲
definition_en: great energy and enthusiasm for a cause, a job, or a belief
core_image: 炉膛里跳动的火：越添柴烧得越旺
scene: 新社团招新那天，干事们冒着雨在校门口发传单，嗓子都喊哑了。The students ran the stall with real zeal, waving leaflets and answering every question.
sceneCN: 这里 zeal 是「热情、干劲」（第 1 个义项：对事业投入的热烈劲头）；句意：学生们带着十足的干劲布置摊位，挥着传单，有问必答。

senses.title: Eager energy for a task
senses.definition: strong and energetic enthusiasm shown in doing something
senses.definitionCN: 做某件事时表现出来的强烈而充满活力的热情
senses.example: She attacked the project with tremendous zeal.
senses.exampleCN: 她以极大的热情投入这个项目。
senses.why: The Greek root zelos meant a boiling, seething heat of the mind, so effort that burns brightly became zeal.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词根 zelos 原指心中沸腾、灼热的状态，于是烧得很旺的劲头就叫 zeal。

senses.title: Enthusiastic loyalty to a cause
senses.titleCN: 对事业的热忱；献身精神
senses.definition: fervent devotion to a cause, group, or belief
senses.definitionCN: 对某种事业、团体或信念的炽热忠诚与投入
senses.example: Their zeal for reform carried the whole campaign.
senses.exampleCN: 他们对改革的热忱撑起了整场运动。
senses.why: Because the heat needs something to burn for, the word often names devotion to a cause rather than mere excitement.
senses.whyCN: 因为火总要有燃料，这个词常指对某项事业的忠诚投入，而不只是单纯的兴奋。

senses.title: Overheated devotion that hardens
senses.definition: an eagerness so intense that it can become uncritical or intolerant
senses.definitionCN: 强烈到可能变得不加分辨或不容异见的热望
senses.example: His religious zeal sometimes made him deaf to other views.
senses.exampleCN: 他的宗教热情有时让他听不进别的看法。
senses.why: Heat with no brake scorches, so the same word shades into the fierce devotion that zealot and zealotry name.
senses.whyCN: 热到没有刹车就会烫伤，于是同一个词也滑向 zealot 与 zealotry 所指的那种猛烈忠诚。

intro.en: Zeal comes from Latin zelus and Greek zelos, a word for boiling heat, rivalry, and eager emulation.
intro.cn: zeal 来自拉丁语 zelus 与希腊语 zelos，原指沸腾的热度、竞争与急切的效仿。

items.en: Zelos means boiling heat, rivalry, and eager emulation.
items.cn: 希腊语 zelos 指沸腾的热度、竞争与热烈的效仿。

items.en: Zelus keeps the sense of warm devotion.
items.cn: 拉丁语 zelus 保留「热烈的忠诚」之义。

items.en: Zele brings the word into French as fervour.
items.cn: 古法语 zele 把这个词带入法语，表示热忱。

items.en: The word enters English with a religious and moral flavour.
items.cn: 该词进入英语，带有宗教与道德的意味。

items.en: Modern English broadens zeal to any strong enthusiasm.
items.cn: 现代英语把 zeal 扩展到任何强烈的热情。

note.en: Zeal is the noun of burning enthusiasm, beside zealous, zealot, and the calmer word eagerness.
note.cn: zeal 是表示「燃烧般热情」的名词，与 zealous、zealot 同族，并与语气较平静的 eagerness 相邻。

normal.en: To work with zeal is to work with real energy.
normal.cn: work with zeal 就是干劲十足地做事。

normal.en: A zeal for learning keeps a student curious.
normal.cn: a zeal for learning 让学习者保持好奇。

normal.en: Zealot and zealotry grow from the same root.

normal.en: Compare enthusiasm: zeal is hotter and often aims at a cause.

abstract.en: Picture a stove fire flaring up when a new log is added.
abstract.cn: 想象往灶里添一根柴，火苗猛地窜起来。

abstract.en: See volunteers staying long after dark to finish the work.
abstract.cn: 想象志愿者天黑很久了还在干活。

abstract.en: Imagine a fire so hot that nothing near it can be touched.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆火烫得近处的东西都碰不得。

examples.cn: 这位年轻老师初登讲台就热情高涨。

examples.cn: 他以近乎信徒的热忱投入这项研究。

examples.en: Their zeal for the cause never faded.
examples.cn: 他们对这项事业的热忱从未消退。

branches.en: Devotion to a cause gives the fire something to burn.

branches.en: Heat without a brake becomes the fierce sense.
branches.cn: 没有刹车的热度成为义项中的猛烈热忱。

branches.en: Energy in a task often grows out of loyalty to a goal.
branches.cn: 做事的干劲往往源于对目标的忠诚。

branches.en: Loyalty to a cause can cool into tolerance or heat into intolerance.
branches.cn: 对事业的忠诚可以化为宽容，也可以烧成不容异见。

scene: 论坛上有人每晚守着帖子，谁提半点质疑就骂上几十行，语气像在宣战。A zealot guards the thread all night and shouts down anyone holding another view.

senses.title: An extreme supporter of a cause
senses.definition: a person who shows uncontrolled enthusiasm for a cause or belief, often refusing to tolerate other views
senses.definitionCN: 对某种事业或信念表现出失控般热忱、常常不容异见的人
senses.example: The reform group was led by a small band of zealots.
senses.exampleCN: 这个改革团体由一小撮狂热分子带领。
senses.why: The Greek zelotes named a person full of zelos, boiling heat, so a zealot is simply the human shape of that heat.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 zelotes 指一个充满 zelos（沸腾热度）的人，所以 zealot 就是这种热度的人格化身。

senses.title: An impassioned partisan
senses.definition: a person who is fiercely devoted to a person, team, or idea in a way that can also be admired
senses.definitionCN: 对某人、某队或某想法极为投入、有时也令人佩服的人
senses.example: My grandfather was a zealot for the local library and never missed a fundraiser.
senses.exampleCN: 我祖父是本地图书馆的痴心拥护者，从不错过一次募款会。
senses.why: Heat is not always bad, so the word can name devotion that reads as loyalty rather than fanaticism.
senses.whyCN: 热度并非总是坏事，因此这个词也可指被看作忠诚而非偏执的投入。

senses.title: A member of the ancient Zealots
senses.definition: a member of a Jewish resistance group in the first century that opposed Roman rule
senses.definitionCN: 公元一世纪反对罗马统治的一个犹太抵抗派别的成员
senses.example: The historian describes the Zealots who held the hilltop fortress.
senses.exampleCN: 这位历史学家描述了据守山顶要塞的奋锐党人。
senses.why: The Greek word entered Judaism as a name for those fervently defending the faith, and history made it a fixed group name.
senses.whyCN: 这个希腊词在犹太教中用来称呼热衷捍卫信仰的人，历史又把它固定成一个派别名称。

intro.en: Zealot comes from Greek zelotes, a zealous person, built on zelos, boiling heat.
intro.cn: zealot 来自希腊语 zelotes（热心的人），由 zelos（沸腾的热度）构成。

items.en: Zelotes names a person full of eager heat or rivalry.
items.cn: 希腊语 zelotes 指充满热切或竞争之心的人。

items.en: Zelotes appears in Latin as a church Latin loan.
items.cn: zelotes 作为教会拉丁语借词进入拉丁语。

items.en: Zealot enters English as a name for a fanatical partisan.
items.cn: zealot 进入英语，指狂热的党派分子。

items.en: The capitalised Zealot fixes on the ancient resistance group.
items.cn: 大写的 Zealot 固定指古代那个抵抗派别。

items.en: Modern English uses zealot for any immoderate enthusiast.
items.cn: 现代英语用 zealot 泛指任何过火的狂热拥护者。

note.en: Zealot is the person noun of the zeal family, beside zeal, zealotry, and the near synonym fanatic.
note.cn: zealot 是 zeal 家族中表示人的名词，与 zeal、zealotry 同族，并与 fanatic 义近。

abstract.cn: 想象一个跑者，别人都停下了他还在大声喊。

abstract.en: See a lamp that is carried too close to a curtain.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯被举得太靠近窗帘。

abstract.en: Think of a guard on a hilltop who will not leave the wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一个守在山顶、死不肯离开城墙的卫兵。

examples.en: Critics dismissed the campaign as the work of zealots.
examples.cn: 批评者把这场运动斥为狂热分子的作为。

examples.en: Even a zealot can be persuaded by clear evidence.
examples.cn: 再狂热的人，也可能被清楚的证据说服。

examples.en: The Zealots were a resistance movement of the first century.
examples.cn: 奋锐党人是公元一世纪的一个抵抗运动。

branches.en: The common sense is the over-eager supporter.
branches.cn: 常见义项是过度热衷的拥护者。

branches.en: The same heat can be read as admirable loyalty.
branches.cn: 同样的热度也可以读作可敬的忠诚。

branches.en: History turned the name into a fixed group label.
branches.cn: 历史把这一称呼固定成了一个派别名称。

branches.en: A partisan and a zealot differ only in how the heat is judged.
branches.cn: 拥护者与狂热者的差别只在于人们如何评价这份热度。

branches.en: Both kinds of zealot put a cause above every other loyalty.
branches.cn: 两类 zealot 都把事业放在一切忠诚之前。

senses.title: Excessive, intolerant enthusiasm
senses.definition: behaviour showing too much enthusiasm for a belief, with no tolerance for other views
senses.definitionCN: 对某种信念表现出过分热情、完全不容异见的行为
senses.example: The article condemned the zealotry of the mob.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章谴责了暴民的狂热。
senses.why: The suffix -ry turns the person word zealot into a name for the behaviour itself, so zealotry is heat without any brake.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ry 把指人的 zealot 变成一种行为名称，所以 zealotry 就是毫无刹车的热度。

senses.title: The mindset of true believers
senses.definition: a state of mind in which people cannot question their own group
senses.definitionCN: 人们无法质疑自己所在团体的那种心理状态
senses.example: Zealotry of this kind makes open debate impossible.
senses.exampleCN: 这种盲信让公开辩论不可能进行。
senses.why: Because the heat is directed by belief, the word can name a closed way of thinking rather than open aggression.
senses.whyCN: 因为这份热度由信念驱动，这个词也可以指一种封闭的思维方式，而不只是公开的攻击。

senses.title: Fervour in a good cause
senses.definition: intense, wholehearted dedication, spoken of without disapproval
senses.definitionCN: 强烈而全心全意的投入，通常不带贬义
senses.example: There is something noble in their zealotry for free schools.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为免费办学的那股热忱里，有某种可贵的东西。
senses.why: Words for extreme heat can sometimes be turned into praise, when the cause itself wins sympathy.
senses.whyCN: 当事业本身博得同情时，表示极端热度的词有时也会被用作褒义。

intro.en: Zealotry builds the noun ending -ry on zealot, which goes back to Greek zelos, boiling heat.

items.en: Zelos means boiling heat and eager rivalry.
items.cn: 希腊语 zelos 指沸腾的热度与热烈的竞争。

items.en: Zelotes names a person full of that heat.
items.cn: 希腊语 zelotes 指充满这种热度的人。

items.en: Zelotes passes into Latin as a religious term.
items.cn: zelotes 作为宗教用语进入拉丁语。

items.en: Zealot plus the suffix -ry forms the abstract noun zealotry.
items.cn: zealot 加词尾 -ry 构成抽象名词 zealotry。

items.en: Modern English keeps zealotry mainly as a term of criticism.
items.cn: 现代英语中 zealotry 主要用作批评用语。

note.en: Zealotry is the abstract noun of the zeal family, close to fanaticism and far in tone from plain zeal.
note.cn: zealotry 是 zeal 家族的抽象名词，与 fanaticism 义近，语气上远比中性的 zeal 更重。

entries.definition: a fanatical supporter
entries.definitionCN: 狂热者

entries.definition: eager enthusiasm
entries.definitionCN: 热情；热忱

entries.definition: full of zeal
entries.definitionCN: 热心的；狂热的

entries.definition: extreme, unreasonable enthusiasm
entries.definitionCN: 狂热；盲信

entries.definition: stubborn intolerance of other opinions
entries.definitionCN: 偏执；顽固不宽容

entries.definition: deep love and loyalty
entries.definitionCN: 挚爱；忠诚

normalIntro.en: Zealotry is the -ry noun of zealot, forming one of those abstract nouns like bigotry.
normalIntro.cn: zealotry 是 zealot 加 -ry 的名词，与 bigotry 这类抽象名词构成方式相同。

normal.en: Zealotry names the behaviour; zealot names the person.
normal.cn: zealotry 指行为，zealot 指人。

normal.en: Religious zealotry is a common fixed pairing.
normal.cn: religious zealotry 是常见固定搭配。

normal.en: The suffix -ry also builds bigotry and rivalry.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ry 也构成 bigotry 与 rivalry。

normal.en: Unlike zeal, zealotry is almost always negative.
normal.cn: 与 zeal 不同，zealotry 几乎总是贬义。

normal.en: Compare fanaticism: zealotry keeps the cause in view.
normal.cn: 对比 fanaticism：zealotry 更强调背后的事业。

abstract.en: Picture a bonfire so big it starts eating the roof beams.
abstract.cn: 想象一堆大火大到开始吞掉房梁。

abstract.en: Imagine a crowd that will not let anyone finish a sentence.
abstract.cn: 想象一群人，谁开口都不许说完。

abstract.en: See a pair of glasses too dark to see the friends beside you.
abstract.cn: 想象一副镜片太黑、连身边朋友都看不见的眼镜。

examples.en: The report warned against zealotry in any political movement.
examples.cn: 报告警告任何政治运动都要避免狂热。

examples.en: His zealotry left no room for doubt or compromise.
examples.cn: 他的偏执不留任何怀疑或妥协的余地。

examples.en: Religious zealotry has caused suffering for centuries.
examples.cn: 宗教狂热已造成数百年的苦难。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「接着抓」——热度一上来就谁也拉不住，见人就抓来同立场，这就是狂热；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 zelos（沸腾的热度）→ zelotes（狂热的人）→ 英语 zealot → zealot + -ry（抽象名词词尾）→ zealotry，核心义「过火而不容异见的热度」。

sensesIntro.en: Zealotry names over-heated behaviour, then the closed mindset behind it, and in rare praise the same heat becomes noble fervour.
sensesIntro.cn: zealotry 先指过火的行为，再指背后的封闭心态，在少见的褒义用法里又变成可贵的热忱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fire that burns so wildly it consumes its own house.
core.cn: 核心意象：烧得太猛、把自家屋子也吞掉的火。

branches.en: The main sense is over-heated, intolerant behaviour.
branches.cn: 主要义项是过火而不宽容的行为。

branches.en: Behind the behaviour lies a mind that cannot doubt.
branches.cn: 行为背后是拒绝怀疑的心态。

branches.en: The same heat can be praised as noble fervour.
branches.cn: 同样的热度也可被称赞为可贵的热情。

branches.en: Loud intolerance and closed belief reinforce each other.
branches.cn: 高声的不宽容与封闭的信念互相强化。

branches.en: The judgement of zealotry depends on how the cause is seen.
branches.cn: 对 zealotry 的评价取决于人们如何看待那项事业。

intro.en: Zealotry is the abstract -ry noun of the zeal family, built on zealot and ultimately on Greek zelos.
intro.cn: zealotry 是 zeal 家族的抽象名词，由 zealot 加 -ry 构成，根源是希腊语 zelos。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin zelotes and zelus carry the Greek heat into European religious language.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 zelotes 与 zelus 把希腊语的热度带进了欧洲的宗教语言。

items.example: Greek zelos is the origin of the family.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语 zelos 是这个词族的源头。

items.example: Greek zelotes gives the person noun.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语 zelotes 提供指人的名词。

items.example: Latin zelus feeds the English forms.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 zelus 滋养英语词形。

items.example: Zealot is the base of zealotry.
items.exampleCN: zealot 是 zealotry 的基础词。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或做法的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ry forms zealotry from zealot.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ry 把 zealot 变成 zealotry。

items.example: Zealotry names intolerant heat.
items.exampleCN: zealotry 指不容异见的热度。

items.example: The suffix -ous forms zealous.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 构成 zealous。

items.example: Zealous describes the eager supporter.
items.exampleCN: zealous 形容热心的拥护者。

items.example: Zeal is the plain noun beside zealotry.
items.exampleCN: zeal 是与 zealotry 相邻的普通名词。

definition_zh: 热心的；热忱的；狂热的；积极支持的
definition_en: full of strong and eager interest in something, often shown through energetic action
core_image: 眼中冒火的人，为一件认定的事奔跑、呼喊、绝不后退
scene: 评选会上，一位年轻志愿者为自己提出的植树计划全力陈词，声音发亮。A zealous young volunteer argued passionately for her tree-planting plan.
sceneCN: 这里 zealous 是「热忱的、全力以赴的」（第 1 个义项：对某事怀有强烈热情并积极投入）；句意：一位热忱的年轻志愿者充满激情地为她的植树计划辩护。

derivatives.zh: 由 zealous 加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「热心地；狂热地」
由希腊语 zelos 词族加 -try 构成，义为「狂热、盲信」，带贬义
由希腊语 zelotes（热心者）经拉丁语、英语而来，义为「狂热分子」

senses.title: Full of eager devotion
senses.definition: showing great and eager enthusiasm for a cause, a person, or a task
senses.definitionCN: 对某项事业、某个人或某项任务表现出强烈而热切的热情
senses.example: She is a zealous supporter of community gardens.
senses.exampleCN: 她是社区花园的热忱支持者。
senses.why: The Greek root zelos meant burning heat and eager rivalry, so the word first names a person whose inner fire shows in action.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语词根 zelos 意为「炽热、热切争胜」，所以这个词首先指一个内心有火、并把它表现在行动上的人。

senses.title: Very active in a duty
senses.definition: working hard and without delay to carry out a duty or an order
senses.definitionCN: 努力且毫不拖延地执行职责或命令
senses.example: The new inspector was zealous in checking every safety rule.
senses.exampleCN: 新来的检查员积极核查每一项安全规定。
senses.why: Because the heat of zelos pushes outward, the word also describes eagerness shown through energetic duty or enforcement.
senses.whyCN: 因为 zelos 的热量是向外推的，所以这个词也用来描述通过卖力履职或执行而表现出的急切。

senses.title: Excessively fanatical
senses.definition: so eager or intense about a belief that one becomes intolerant or unreasonable
senses.definitionCN: 对某种信念过于热切强烈，以致变得不宽容或不讲理
senses.example: His zealous attacks on rivals frightened even his allies.
senses.exampleCN: 他对对手的狂热攻击甚至吓到了自己的盟友。
senses.why: When the fire of zelos burns past the point of reason, the same energy is judged as fanatical, so the word turns negative.
senses.whyCN: 当 zelos 的火烧过了理智的边界，同一股能量就被视为狂热，于是这个词变成贬义。

intro.en: Zealous comes from Latin zelosus, from Greek zelos, burning heat, eager rivalry, and jealousy.
intro.cn: zealous 来自拉丁语 zelosus，上溯希腊语 zelos，意为炽热、热切争胜与嫉妒。

items.en: Zelos means burning heat, eager rivalry, and zeal.
items.cn: zelos 意为炽热、热切争胜与热忱。

items.en: Latin zelosus means full of zeal, formed from zelus with the suffix -osus.
items.cn: 拉丁语 zelosus 意为充满热忱，由 zelus 加后缀 -osus 构成。

items.en: Old French zelous or zelous carries the adjective into western Europe.
items.cn: 古法语 zelous 把这个形容词带入西欧。

items.en: English zealous appears in sixteenth-century religious writing.
items.cn: 英语 zealous 在十六世纪的宗教写作中出现。

items.en: The word widens to politics, sport, and work, keeping a hint of excess.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到政治、体育与工作领域，同时保留了「过度」的一丝意味。

note.en: Zealous belongs to the zelos word family and sits beside everyday words for enthusiasm, with a built-in warning about excess.
note.cn: zealous 属于 zelos 词族，与表示「热情」的日常词相邻，并自带「过度」的提醒。

entries.definitionCN: 热忱；热情

entries.definition: in a very eager and active way
entries.definitionCN: 热心地；狂热地

entries.definitionCN: 狂热分子

entries.definitionCN: 热情的；强烈的

entries.definitionCN: 忠诚的；献身的

normalIntro.en: Zealous carries the image of zelos, a burning flame of eager rivalry shared by zeal, zealot, and jealous.
normalIntro.cn: zealous 带着 zelos 的意象：一团热切争胜的火，与 zeal、zealot、jealous 同源。

normal.en: Zeal is the noun behind zealous, meaning eager energy.
normal.cn: zeal 是 zealous 背后的名词，意为热忱与干劲。

normal.en: Add the adjective suffix -ous and zeal becomes zealous.
normal.cn: 给 zeal 加上形容词后缀 -ous，就得到 zealous。

normal.en: A zealot is a person ruled by zeal, and zealous describes that kind of person.
normal.cn: zealot 是被热忱驱动的人，zealous 正是形容这类人。

normal.en: Latin zelosus and Greek zelos explain why the word can carry a sense of jealousy.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 zelosus 与希腊语 zelos 解释了为什么这个词可带上嫉妒的意味。

normal.en: Forms like zealous supporter and zealous efforts show the word at work.
normal.cn: zealous supporter 与 zealous efforts 这样的搭配展示了它的实际用法。

abstract.en: Picture a candle flame leaning forward as if it wants to run.
abstract.cn: 想象一束烛火向前倾斜，仿佛想奔跑。

abstract.en: Imagine a volunteer arriving early with a box full of tools.
abstract.cn: 想象一位志愿者早早到场，抱着一整箱工具。

abstract.en: Think of a fire that grows so large it starts to singe the curtains.
abstract.cn: 想象一团火越烧越大，开始燎到窗帘。

examples.en: The zealous fans queued overnight for the concert tickets.
examples.cn: 狂热的歌迷彻夜排队买演唱会门票。

examples.en: As a zealous reader, he finishes a novel every week.
examples.cn: 他是热忱的读者，每周读完一本小说。

examples.en: Her zealous defence of the project won over the committee.
examples.cn: 她对项目的热忱辩护赢得了委员会的支持。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「责了事」——把每件事都当作自己的责任，热心得近乎狂热；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 zelos（炽热；热切争胜；嫉妒）→ 拉丁语 zelus、zelosus（充满热忱的）→ 古法语 zelous → 英语 zealous，核心义「心中燃烧、为某事全力以赴」。

sensesIntro.en: Zealous begins with eager devotion, extends to energetic duty, and turns negative when the same fire burns beyond reason.
sensesIntro.cn: zealous 先指热忱投入，再扩展到卖力履职，最后在同一团火烧过理智时转为贬义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person burning with zeal, running toward what they care about.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人内心燃着火，奔向自己在乎的事情。

branches.en: The warm everyday sense is eager devotion.
branches.cn: 温暖的日常义项是热忱投入。

branches.en: Zeal expressed through work becomes energetic duty.
branches.cn: 通过工作表达的热忱变成卖力履职。

branches.en: The same fire beyond reason becomes fanaticism.
branches.cn: 同一团火越过理智就成了狂热。

branches.en: A zealous supporter shows both devotion and tireless action.
branches.cn: 热忱的支持者既表现出投入，也表现出不知疲倦的行动。

branches.en: An official can be called zealous for eager or for excessive enforcement.
branches.cn: 一位官员可因积极执行或因执行过激而被说成 zealous。

intro.en: Zealous is built from the Greek stem zelos plus the Latin adjective suffix -osus, and English root forms such as zealous and zealously.
intro.cn: zealous 由希腊语词干 zelos 加拉丁语形容词后缀 -osus 构成，英语中另有 zeal、zealot、zealously 等同源形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin zelus and zelosus pass the Greek flame into European languages.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 zelus 与 zelosus 把希腊语的火种带进欧洲各语言。

items.example: Zelos gives the word its burning energy.
items.exampleCN: zelos 为这个词提供了燃烧般的能量。

items.example: Zelus is the Latin borrowing of the Greek noun.
items.exampleCN: zelus 是拉丁语对希腊语名词的借用。

items.example: The suffix -osus turns zelus into zelosus.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -osus 把 zelus 变成 zelosus。

items.example: Old French carries the adjective forward.
items.exampleCN: 古法语把这个形容词继续传下去。

items.example: Zeal is the short noun at the centre of the family.
items.exampleCN: zeal 是这个词族的中心名词。

items.example: The suffix -ous forms zealous from zeal.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ous 把 zeal 变成 zealous。

items.example: The adverb -ly forms zealously.
items.exampleCN: 副词词尾 -ly 构成 zealously。

items.example: Zealot shares the same Greek root.
items.exampleCN: zealot 共享同一希腊词根。

items.example: Zealotry names the excess of zeal.
items.exampleCN: zealotry 指热忱的过度伸展。
